# CloudVerse

CloudVerse is an economic intelligence and FinOps control plane for cloud + AI spend. It helps engineering, finance, and leadership connect unit economics, architecture decisions, and cost outcomes across multi-cloud and AI workloads.

## Primary audience
- CTO / VP Engineering / Platform Engineering
- FinOps / Cloud Financial Management
- CFO / Finance leadership (cost transparency + allocation + governance)
- Engineering managers and service owners

## What CloudVerse helps with
- Cloud cost visibility that maps spend to engineering ownership
- Accurate allocation and tagging strategy
- Cost anomaly detection with context
- Multi-cloud cost governance and architectural discipline
- AI cost management operating model (beyond “just dashboards”)
